gloss: having a stomachache; hilarious enough to hurt

definitions.gloss: having a stomachache; one's stomach hurts
definitions.explanation: Casual i-adjective form of 'stomach hurts', built from {腹|はら} (stomach) + {痛|いた}い (painful). Used as a direct complaint about an upset stomach.

definitions.gloss: so funny it hurts; gut-bustingly funny
definitions.explanation: Colloquial figurative use, said when something is so hilarious that one's stomach actually aches from laughing. Equivalent to English 'my stomach hurts from laughing'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{腹|はら}{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: My stomach has been hurting since yesterday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|た}べすぎて{腹|はら}{痛|いた}く⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I ate too many cold things and got a stomachache.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{腹|はら}{痛|いた}くて、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: My stomach's been hurting since this morning, so I decided to take the day off.

examples.japanese: {腹|はら}{痛|いた}い、⟦{笑|わら}いすぎ→笑いすぎ：08974_waraisugi⟧た。
examples.english: My stomach hurts — I laughed too much.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧、{腹|はら}{痛|いた}いくらい⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: This video is so funny my stomach hurts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ものまね⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎回|まいかい}→毎回：13202_maikai⟧{腹|はら}{痛|いた}く⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ほど⟦{爆笑|ばくしょう}して→爆笑する：26846_bakushousuru⟧しまう。
examples.english: His impressions always crack me up until my stomach actually hurts.

notes:
Casual fused adjective. In careful speech, sense 1 would be ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧; {腹|はら}{痛|いた}い is a shortened, more abrupt version typical of male speech and online posts.

REGISTER:
- Casual; avoid in business or to superiors. Use ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧ or ⟦{腹痛|ふくつう}→腹痛：05019_fukutsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ in polite contexts.
- Sense 2 (so funny it hurts) is especially common in social media and chat.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: standard, neutral form
- ⟦{腹痛|ふくつう}→腹痛：05019_fukutsuu⟧: stomachache (formal noun, used by doctors and on packaging)
- ⟦{笑|わら}いすぎ→笑いすぎ：08974_waraisugi⟧て⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: literal version of sense 2 in polite speech
